versions.name: Camp Parsons

features.note: An open-water salt-water base on Hood Canal used for all aquatic activities; the council calls it one of the few camps to do so.
Canoeing on glassy salt water along a forested shoreline.

versions.summary: Historic Hood Canal resident camp at the foot of the Olympic Mountains, offering sailing, kayaking, and mountain treks. Facilities include a waterfront, dining hall, shooting sports, and climbing, plus an older Scout program and high-adventure options.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Website canonicalised 2026-07-25: https://seattlebsa.org/camp-parsons/ now redirects to https://scoutingseattle.org/camp-parsons/ (link audit, tools/check_urls.py). Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence). Some codes are retained from the original camp-finder import and were not re-confirmed by this survey.
